description: Inspection island framed by arrow/spear racks, three metallic armor effigies, cabinet and anvil.
differences: Armor silhouettes use supported metal-block effigies, not interactive equipped armor-stand entities.
Racks use iron bars; no actual weapons/arrows or magical locked cabinet.
Coral survives in shallow perimeter pools; complete glass-beamed roof, dry side ports.
water_policy: DRY HABITABLE COMPARTMENT, contained wet aquarium planters and shallow pools; not a fully flooded ocean ruin. All route goals remain dry. Glass enclosure for deployment preparation, not certified deep-ocean pressure/oxygen safety.
